dialog.body: Newport Utilities, water division, this is Priya. How can I help you?

Hello, yes, this is Ivone Lopes, I'm at 341 Memorial Boulevard, down toward Easton's Beach. I got my water bill and it's almost double. Double! I've been in that house a long time and it never goes up like that, not even the summer my sister's grandkids stayed over, and they ran the hose all day, so.
I'm sorry about that, Ms. Lopes. Let me pull up the account. Do you know roughly what you usually pay, and what this one is?

Usually it's, oh, in the neighborhood of eighty something. This one, wait, I have it here, it's over a hundred and sixty. And I can't explain it. I live alone, I'm not home all day, I'm not filling a pool.
Okay. I see the account. The reading this cycle is quite a bit higher than the previous ones. Has anything changed at the house, any leaks, a dripping faucet, anything running?

Well, now that you say it, the toilet. The toilet was running constantly last month. That jiggling handle thing, you know? My neighbor had the same thing, his was the flapper, he told me, and he's got the bad knee so I didn't want him coming over. Anyway, it ran for I'd say two, three weeks before I got it fixed.
That could easily account for it. A running toilet can use a surprising amount of water over a few weeks. Is it fixed now?
It's fixed, yes. A fellow came and put the part in. So that's the whole reason, you think? Because I'm annoyed, I'll tell you, I didn't use that water. It just went down the drain.

I understand. The meter measures what passes through, whether it's used or not, so the bill reflects it. If the next reading comes back to normal, that will confirm the repair worked. Would you like to know how to pay this one?

Yes, that's the other thing. I work days. I'm out the door early and I have to be back by noon, because I trade shifts with my cousin, she takes the afternoon, I take the morning. So I can't get to City Hall at your hours. Can I pay in person after four thirty, or in the evening?

The counter closes at the regular end of the business day, so there's no in-person payment in the evening. But you have options. There's a drop box outside City Hall you can use any time, and you can pay online through the city's website whenever you like, even at night. You can also mail a check with the bill stub.
The drop box, is that, like, safe? Is it by the front door?
Yes, it's by the main entrance, and it's emptied by staff each business day. Put a check in an envelope with the stub or your account number written on it. Please don't put cash in it.
No, no, I'd use a check. Fine. The drop box I can do on my way home. Honestly the online I don't trust, my grandson set up something once and I got locked out.
That's fine, the drop box works. If you'd like, I can note on the account that the high reading came from a repaired toilet leak, so it's on record.
Yes, put that down. It's still a lot of money for a toilet.
I've noted it. Anything else I can do for you today?
No, that's it. Thank you, Priya. Goodbye.
You're welcome, Ms. Lopes. Take care.
